evals.prompt: Sketch a minimal Dart entry point for a package:noir status screen that displays Ready. I already depend on Noir. How do I check that it renders inside an 80-column terminal?
evals.expected_output: A runnable Noir-only screen and a way to inspect it at a known width.
expectations: Uses package:noir/noir.dart, runTuiApp and a public text widget.
Checks visual output using a real terminal or a compatible driver at the requested geometry.
Distinguishes a headless lifecycle check from a rendered frame.

evals.prompt: A Noir TUI search field no longer receives the letter q after I registered a global quit shortcut. How would you isolate and verify the fix without changing my project's dependencies?
evals.expected_output: An input-routing diagnosis and a narrow interactive regression check.
expectations: Examines app-level key handling and focus before changing the text field.
Checks event handling against the resolved Noir package.
Exercises typing q into the focused field and quitting through the intended shortcut.
